nodes.name: mlg_page_map
nodes.summary: MySQL/InnoDB migration creating the mlg_page_map table that persistently maps a Meta (Facebook) page_id to its connected REGOS integration, with page name, active flag, and audit timestamps; transient lead-gen state stays in Redis.
nodes.languageNotes: Idempotent CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS with utf8mb4 charset; secondary indexes on connected_integration_id and is_active for lookup filtering, and an ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP audit column.
